rows.meaning: Pays network fee and signs the complete V1 message. Signer=True; writable=True.
rows.formedBy: Configured registered Cranker operator Ed25519 public key.
rows.nextCredit: Can repeat for the same operator; infrastructure linkage.

rows.meaning: Co-signs the exact permitted settlement; used as CPI payer/authority. Signer=True; writable=True.
rows.formedBy: Authority stored in canonical MotherEscrow.
rows.nextCredit: Can repeat until authority rotation; infrastructure linkage.

rows.meaning: TCAP accounting state for this accepted asset. Signer=False; writable=True.
rows.formedBy: TCAP PDA: [tcap:reserve-state:v1, assetEntry bytes].
rows.nextCredit: Repeats for the same asset/reserve; not a recipient account.

rows.meaning: Stores global head/nullifier-map root and sequence. Signer=False; writable=True.
rows.formedBy: TCAP PDA: [tcap:commitment-root:v1].
rows.nextCredit: Address repeats; root data changes across settlements.

rows.meaning: TSNP PDA that signs the TCAP CPI for this digest. Signer=False; writable=False.
rows.formedBy: TSNP PDA: [tsn:tcap-authorization:v1, authorizationDigest bytes].
rows.nextCredit: Changes when digest changes; deterministic from public fields. No standalone account creation here.

rows.meaning: Configured Groth16 verifying-key/IC account. Signer=False; writable=False.
rows.formedBy: GPRU PDA: [gpru:hidden-head-verifier:v1].
rows.nextCredit: Shared verifier address normally repeats.

rows.meaning: Global TCAP authority/program policy. Signer=False; writable=False.
rows.formedBy: TCAP PDA: [tcap:global-config:v1].
rows.nextCredit: Shared account normally repeats.

rows.meaning: Executes hidden-head proof/Memo validation. Signer=False; writable=False.
rows.formedBy: Configured deployed program ID.
rows.nextCredit: Program ID repeats.

rows.meaning: Authenticates private membership in the shared TIP route tree. Signer=False; writable=False.
rows.formedBy: TIP PDA: [tip:route-merkle-root:v1].
rows.nextCredit: Address repeats; shared root value repeats until TIP membership changes.

rows.meaning: Maps public tokenId to mint, decimals and reserve policy. Signer=False; writable=False.
rows.formedBy: TCAP PDA: [tcap:asset-entry:v1, registry bytes, tokenProgram bytes, mint bytes].
rows.nextCredit: Repeats for the same registered asset; asset is visible.

rows.meaning: Mother configuration/authority context. Signer=False; writable=False.
rows.formedBy: TSNP PDA: [tsn_mother_escrow].
rows.nextCredit: Shared protocol account; expected to repeat.

rows.meaning: Logs the canonical encrypted action Memo. Signer=False; writable=False.
rows.formedBy: Solana Memo program ID.
rows.nextCredit: Program ID repeats.

rows.meaning: Lets GPRU inspect the top-level caller and following Memo. Signer=False; writable=False.
rows.formedBy: Canonical Solana instructions sysvar address.
rows.nextCredit: Shared sysvar repeats.

rows.meaning: Executes reserve/root accounting after proof validation. Signer=False; writable=False.
rows.formedBy: Configured deployed TCAP program ID.
rows.nextCredit: Program ID repeats.

rows.meaning: Enforces Mother authority, digest and slot conditions. Signer=False; writable=False.
rows.formedBy: Configured deployed TSNP program ID.
rows.nextCredit: Program ID repeats.

rows.meaning: Wire version discriminator.
rows.formedBy: Fixed hexadecimal 0x81 for actual V1.
rows.nextCredit: Repeats for V1.

rows.meaning: Decoded Solana message version.
rows.formedBy: Version marker low bits.
rows.nextCredit: Repeats for this encoding.

rows.meaning: Number of trailing signatures.
rows.formedBy: Payer plus Mother signer account metas.
rows.nextCredit: Usually 2 for this branch.

rows.meaning: Number of readonly signer addresses.
rows.formedBy: Message account-role compiler.
rows.nextCredit: Normally repeats for the same instruction roles.

rows.meaning: Number of readonly nonsigner addresses.
rows.formedBy: Message account-role compiler.
rows.nextCredit: Normally repeats for the same instruction roles.

rows.meaning: Inline V1 compute/loaded-account configuration flags.
rows.formedBy: Mask 12 enables the two u32 limits.
rows.nextCredit: Repeats for this builder.

rows.meaning: Transaction lifetime and replay context.
rows.formedBy: Confirmed getLatestBlockhash RPC response.
rows.nextCredit: Can repeat for transactions prepared under the same blockhash; is not recipient identity.

rows.meaning: Two top-level calls: TSNP then Memo.
rows.formedBy: Builder instruction list; CPI calls do not add top-level instructions.
rows.nextCredit: Repeats for this branch.

rows.meaning: Distinct inline account addresses.
rows.formedBy: Deduplicated account-role list.
rows.nextCredit: Normally 15 for this branch.

rows.meaning: Requested execution compute ceiling in compute units.
rows.formedBy: V1 builder configuration 1400000.
rows.nextCredit: Repeats unless policy changes.

rows.meaning: Requested loaded-account ceiling in bytes.
rows.formedBy: V1 builder configuration 64 MiB.
rows.nextCredit: Repeats unless policy changes.

rows.meaning: Serialized message size before signatures.
rows.formedBy: Byte count; includes compressed encrypted record size.
rows.nextCredit: Can repeat or change; length is observable.

rows.meaning: Complete transaction size including signatures.
rows.formedBy: Message bytes plus 128 signature bytes.
rows.nextCredit: Can repeat or change; size is observable.

rows.meaning: Inspection fingerprint of the complete public transaction.
rows.formedBy: Analyst SHA-256 over wire bytes; not an additional on-chain field.
rows.nextCredit: Changes when any wire byte changes.

rows.meaning: Ed25519 signature over identical complete message bytes; payer signature identifies this transaction.
rows.formedBy: Signer private key signs public message; private key is not published.
rows.nextCredit: Normally changes when message changes; same key can sign another message.

rows.meaning: Ed25519 signature over identical complete message bytes; payer signature identifies this transaction.
rows.formedBy: Signer private key signs public message; private key is not published.
rows.nextCredit: Normally changes when message changes; same key can sign another message.

rows.meaning: Selects tsn_register_tcap_credit_authorization_v2.
rows.formedBy: First 8 bytes of SHA256(global:tsn_register_tcap_credit_authorization_v2).
rows.nextCredit: Repeats for this instruction.

rows.meaning: Binds root, sequence, time window, amount, token and nullifier to Mother authorization.
rows.formedBy: SHA256(TSN_GPRU_TCAP_CREDIT_HIDDEN_HEAD_V1\0 || rootAccount || oldRoot || LE64(sequence,validAfter,expires,amount) || LE32(tokenId) || nullifier).
rows.nextCredit: Expected to change for a new deposit/root/window; publicly recomputable.

rows.meaning: Earliest slot where authorization may execute.
rows.formedBy: Confirmed slot selected by Node.
rows.nextCredit: Changes with preparation slot; can repeat for same-slot preparations.

rows.meaning: Latest execution slot.
rows.formedBy: validAfterSlot + configured TTL, 2000 slots here.
rows.nextCredit: Changes with validity window.

rows.meaning: Expected global state immediately before credit.
rows.formedBy: Current chain-selected TCAP root.
rows.nextCredit: Should equal baseline newGlobalRoot for the immediate next transition with no interleaving.

rows.meaning: Global shared-root sequence, not the private TIN action sequence.
rows.formedBy: Chain sequence + 1.
rows.nextCredit: Advances globally; immediate next transition should be 2.

rows.meaning: TCAP registered accepted-asset identifier.
rows.formedBy: Asset entry token_id; ID 1 maps to the observed Devnet USDC mint.
rows.nextCredit: Repeats for the same asset; asset selection is public.

rows.meaning: Public credited deposit amount; 100000 with 6 decimals is 0.1 Devnet USDC.
rows.formedBy: Confirmed owner-signed deposit amount.
rows.nextCredit: Repeats if the next amount is equal; amount is not hidden.

rows.meaning: Consumed-deposit replay binding stored inside the authenticated map.
rows.formedBy: SHA256(TSN_GPRU_CONFIRMED_DEPOSIT_NULLIFIER_V1\0 || TCAP program bytes || decoded funding signature) reduced modulo BN254 q.
rows.nextCredit: Changes for a different deposit; identical for retries of the same deposit. Public funding-to-credit link.

rows.meaning: Shared authenticated state before this action.
rows.formedBy: Poseidon(previous private head-map root, previous nullifier-map root).
rows.nextCredit: Expected shared-state continuity; not a per-recipient public predecessor.

rows.meaning: Shared authenticated state after this action.
rows.formedBy: Poseidon(updated private head-map root, updated nullifier-map root).
rows.nextCredit: Expected to change for every accepted state transition.

rows.meaning: Binds the complete following Memo bytes.
rows.formedBy: SHA256(complete ASCII Memo) reduced modulo BN254 q.
rows.nextCredit: Changes when Memo changes; current value is publicly recomputable.

rows.meaning: Binds authorized action fields.
rows.formedBy: Poseidon(1, tokenId, amount, authorizationCommitment, nullifier). All five inputs are public in this transaction.
rows.nextCredit: Expected to change with public action inputs; not a secret salted recipient identifier.

rows.meaning: Same consumed-deposit nullifier as the outer argument.
rows.formedBy: Copied into the proof statement.
rows.nextCredit: Same repeat/link rule as outer nullifier.

rows.meaning: Shared TIP membership tree root.
rows.formedBy: Chain-selected public TIP route root.
rows.nextCredit: Can repeat while membership is unchanged; shared across recipients.

rows.meaning: Committed root of the hidden recipient token portfolio after credit.
rows.formedBy: Sparse token map with leaf Poseidon(tokenId, successorBalanceX, successorBalanceY).
rows.nextCredit: Expected to change with freshly blinded successor point; previous portfolio root is private in next witness.

rows.meaning: X of successor BabyJubjub Pedersen balance point.
rows.formedBy: Pnew = Pold + amount*G + freshDelta*H.
rows.nextCredit: Expected to change; previous point should not be explicitly published by the next credit ABI.

rows.meaning: Y of the same successor balance point.
rows.formedBy: Same Pedersen point update; coordinate is public, opening remains private.
rows.nextCredit: Same rule as X; point difference alone does not certify unlinkability.

rows.meaning: Owner-readable scalar encryption of the exact Pedersen blinding delta.
rows.formedBy: C = freshDelta + x(e*S) mod BabyJubjub subgroup order.
rows.nextCredit: Expected to change with fresh blinding/ephemeral randomness.

rows.meaning: X of one-time BabyJubjub delta-encryption point.
rows.formedBy: E = e*Base8, fresh ephemeral scalar e.
rows.nextCredit: Expected to change with fresh e; recipient S is private in the proof witness.

rows.meaning: Y of the same one-time point.
rows.formedBy: Same E = e*Base8.
rows.nextCredit: Same rule as X.

rows.meaning: 64-byte Groth16 G1 proof point encoding.
rows.formedBy: Circuit witness + proving key + Groth16 prover randomness, encoded for the GPRU verifier.
rows.nextCredit: Normally changes for a fresh proof; different proof bytes alone do not establish privacy.

rows.meaning: 128-byte Groth16 G2 proof point encoding.
rows.formedBy: Circuit witness + proving key + Groth16 prover randomness, encoded for the GPRU verifier.
rows.nextCredit: Normally changes for a fresh proof; different proof bytes alone do not establish privacy.

rows.meaning: 64-byte Groth16 G1 proof point encoding.
rows.formedBy: Circuit witness + proving key + Groth16 prover randomness, encoded for the GPRU verifier.
rows.nextCredit: Normally changes for a fresh proof; different proof bytes alone do not establish privacy.

rows.meaning: Credit selector, 1.
rows.formedBy: Prover result binds action/token/amount and reduced authorization digest to the same witness.
rows.nextCredit: Action kind/asset/amount may repeat; authorization scalar generally changes.

rows.meaning: Public copy of token/amount bound to TCAP and circuit.
rows.formedBy: Prover result binds action/token/amount and reduced authorization digest to the same witness.
rows.nextCredit: Action kind/asset/amount may repeat; authorization scalar generally changes.

rows.meaning: Public copy of token/amount bound to TCAP and circuit.
rows.formedBy: Prover result binds action/token/amount and reduced authorization digest to the same witness.
rows.nextCredit: Action kind/asset/amount may repeat; authorization scalar generally changes.

rows.meaning: BN254 scalar reduction of authorizationDigest; public.
rows.formedBy: Prover result binds action/token/amount and reduced authorization digest to the same witness.
rows.nextCredit: Action kind/asset/amount may repeat; authorization scalar generally changes.

rows.meaning: Selects the hidden-head owner-record Memo format.
rows.formedBy: TSN_GPRU_HEAD_V1 prefix + seven colon-separated proof fields + unpadded Base64URL JSON body.
rows.nextCredit: Prefix repeats; lengths can repeat; complete Memo hash changes with any bytes.

rows.meaning: Complete public Memo instruction data length in bytes.
rows.formedBy: TSN_GPRU_HEAD_V1 prefix + seven colon-separated proof fields + unpadded Base64URL JSON body.
rows.nextCredit: Prefix repeats; lengths can repeat; complete Memo hash changes with any bytes.

rows.meaning: Full SHA-256 fingerprint of the complete ASCII Memo; its scalar reduction is memoCommitment.
rows.formedBy: Inspector hashes the public Memo bytes.
rows.nextCredit: Prefix repeats; lengths can repeat; complete Memo hash changes with any bytes.

rows.meaning: ASCII length of the unpadded Base64URL JSON body after the seven public fields.
rows.formedBy: TSN_GPRU_HEAD_V1 prefix + seven colon-separated proof fields + unpadded Base64URL JSON body.
rows.nextCredit: Prefix repeats; lengths can repeat; complete Memo hash changes with any bytes.

rows.meaning: Byte length of the decoded JSON envelope; this is still encrypted-record metadata.
rows.formedBy: TSN_GPRU_HEAD_V1 prefix + seven colon-separated proof fields + unpadded Base64URL JSON body.
rows.nextCredit: Prefix repeats; lengths can repeat; complete Memo hash changes with any bytes.

rows.meaning: Owner-record cipher identifier.
rows.formedBy: Literal dbrix-core-secretbox-v1.
rows.nextCredit: Repeats for this cipher.

rows.meaning: Compression of typed action plaintext before encryption.
rows.formedBy: Deflate used when it reduces size.
rows.nextCredit: May repeat; compressed length is visible.

rows.meaning: Fresh public record salt/context, not the owner secret.
rows.formedBy: Node secrets.token_bytes(32); included in the record-key hash.
rows.nextCredit: Expected to change per record.

rows.meaning: Compressed Ristretto point for owner-record key agreement; distinct from BabyJubjub E.
rows.formedBy: Fresh scalar r times record generator; shared point is r*ownerRecordScanPublic.
rows.nextCredit: Expected to change; owner public key is not copied into this envelope.

rows.meaning: Encrypted envelope schema version.
rows.formedBy: Literal 1.
rows.nextCredit: Repeats for this schema.

rows.meaning: 303 ciphertext bytes here; persisted as length/hash instead of raw ciphertext.
rows.formedBy: SecretBox key K=SHA256(DBRIX_GPRU_TRANSACTION_RECORD_KEY_V1\0 || sharedPoint || DNA || recordEphemeralPublicKey).
rows.nextCredit: Ciphertext/hash expected to change; length may repeat.

rows.meaning: Public 24-byte SecretBox nonce.
rows.formedBy: Fresh secrets.token_bytes(24).
rows.nextCredit: Expected to change per encryption.
